Soup Kitchen is a production building unlocked at experience level 46.

It is used to make bell pepper soup, fish soup, lobster soup, noodle soup, onion soup, potato soup, mushroom soup, pumpkin soup, and tomato soup.

Appearance

The Soup Kitchen is a cyan stove with a blue pot and a vegetable cutter placed on it. Pots and pans are placed or hung near it. There are a couple of utensils hanging beside the stove.

The mastered version gains a golden tint on the stove and the rims of the pot. Steam comes out of the star-decorated pot on the stove.

Building

It costs 115,000 coin and takes 1 day and 12 hours (or 57 dia) to build the Soup Kitchen. It gives players 28 xp when completed.

Upgrading

Main article: Production Buildings

The Soup Kitchen originally has two slots available. Unlocking the third slot costs 6 diamonds. Players can unlock 7 new slots in total, each new one costing 3 more dia than the previous one. Alternatively, they can spend a total of 105 dia to completely upgrade their machine.

Mastering

A total of 1,512 hours of production is required to master the Soup Kitchen:

★
72 hrs 		★★
288 hrs 		★★★
1,152 hrs
+10% coin +5% xp 15% faster

Strategy tips

  • After the lobster soup is unlocked, make as much as you can as it is requested often and it is profitable. After level 50, focus on tomato soup as it too is widely requested.
  • You can speed up the production of the Soup Kitchen using a green booster.
  • Fish Soup has the longest time of production in this machine, 3 hours of cooking time. Use this product if you want to master the machine.

Did you know?

The appearance of the Soup Kitchen changed in September 2015.
